blends.name: Tamed Toucan - True Form
blends.desc:
# AI Geometrics x NFTOPIA 5 - Limited Edition Set!
**Tamed Toucan - True Form Version**

Welcome to the latest AI Geometrics drop, with a very special occassion. We are participating in the NFTOPIA 5 Collab Blend along many amazing collections and artists! NFTOPIA is a virtual metaverse expo where various projects, artists and web3 enthusiast get together to share and connect. Feel free to find out more about NFTOPIA at: https://nftopia.weebly.com/

----------

"Mysterious creature from the rainforest, hidden even to the Maya. Rarely do they appear in written remnants, but their presence in the jungle escapes even you and me. For if this was on purpose, the answer shall remain unclear. Yet they remain, energetic as ever as their peculiar sounds populate the depths, behind the ceiba trees. Hopping up and down, their notable beaks denote their mark. Fierce in their territory, yet lovers of all fruit Yum Kaax can provide. If you see one, good luck might find its way to you..."

MP4 - 1750 x 1250 px - 20 seconds
PNG - 3500 x 2500 px

----------

This NFT can be staked to earn the $WAXART token. For more information, please go to https://linktr.ee/waxarttoken

blends.name: Distant Sights Pack $WAXART Recycling
blends.desc:
One year has passed since our Season 3 Distant Sights series, and the window for redeeming the packs has closed! 
Collector, we are giving you a choice: recycling!

This blend will only have 10 uses in total, 1 per wallet. Open to anyone, old or new.
Each time, 20K WAXART tokens are rewarded to the collector who chooses to recycle their pack.
200K WAXART tokens will remain locked here, waiting to be claimed.

The packs are still stakeable in our updated [Pepperstake farm](https://pepperstake.online/pool/455)! This will only be available until 5/5/2026.

Find out more about AI Geometrics at our [Linktree](https://linktr.ee/aigeometrics/)

Find out more about the WAXart Collective [here](https://linktr.ee/waxarttoken/)
